d:
Nitish Setu ke nirman men kiska yogdan raha, ise lekar bihar men siyasi bayanbaji tej ho gaee hai. vipaksh ke aaropon par NDA netaon ne palatvar karte hue apna paksh rakha aur nirman men yogdan ko lekar savalon ke javab die. dekhie NDA netaon ne kya kaha aur vipaksh par kaise nishana sadha.
About Channel:
ABP Bihar pradesh ki khabron ka ek aisa chainal hai jahan pradesh se juri har khabar aapke pas sabse pahle pahunchti hai. bihar ki rajniti, bihar ki barh, lalu - nitish ka ek dusre par palatvar, apradh ki andruni khabar aapke pas tathyon ke sath lekar aata hai.
